title: Goods receipts
empty: This warehouse has no goods receipts yet.
noWarehouse: You are not assigned to any warehouse yet.
warehouseInactive: This warehouse is inactive — new receipts cannot be created.
fieldCodeHint: 2–32 letters, digits or hyphens; cannot start or end with a hyphen.
itemsMaxReached: 200 lines reached — the maximum for one receipt.
fileHint: Up to 10 MB. Downloading is not supported yet — the file is only stored with the receipt.
fileTooLarge: File must be 10 MB or smaller.
createConfirmDescription: The receipt is created as a Draft; stock is not changed yet.
conflict: Someone else just changed this receipt — reloaded the latest version.
notFound: Goods receipt not found (it may have been deleted).
notEditable: This receipt is no longer a Draft or you are not allowed to edit it.
confirmDescription: Stock will be increased by the receipt lines. A confirmed receipt can no longer be edited or deleted.
cancelDescription: The receipt becomes Cancelled and stock is not changed. This cannot be undone.
deleteDescription: The draft is deleted and the code {{code}} cannot be reused.
itemsRequired: A receipt needs at least 1 line
quantityInvalid: Quantity must be > 0 with at most 6 decimals
unitPriceInvalid: Unit price must be ≥ 0 with at most 2 decimals
itemDuplicated: This material and unit already appear on another line
addMaterialDescription: {{warehouse}} · materials added to the warehouse stay there even if you discard this receipt.
addMaterialSearch: Search the catalog by code or name
catalogNotInWarehouse: In the catalog, not in this warehouse
catalogEmpty: No materials outside this warehouse match.
catalogAlreadyInWarehouse: This material is already in the warehouse — pick it directly in the line.
alreadyInWarehouseToast: {{name}} is already in the warehouse — selected in the line
createMaterialHint: A new material only has its base unit — add conversion units on the material detail page.
createdToast: Created {{name}} and added it to the warehouse
supplierAttachFailed: Created and added to the warehouse, but the supplier could not be attached — attach it on the Suppliers screen.
needAssignPermission: Requires material update and warehouse update permissions — contact an administrator.
needCreatePermission: Requires material create/update, warehouse update and unit read permissions — contact an administrator.
